text:
sienna: Hey folks — moving on Friday, have a solid oak 5-shelf bookcase (approx 72in x 30in) and 2 SF Giants tickets (section 118) to give away. Photos: https://imgur.com/a/example (curbside pickup SOMA)

morgan: woah that bookcase sounds perfect. any scratches? weight? :eyes:

sienna: pretty good shape, one tiny scuff on the side, no wobble. I can help carry down the stairs. it's heavy tho, needs two people.

ben: I can swing by for the tickets if still available — date?

sienna: tickets are for June 10th 7pm. free to whoever claims them first.

alex: I'm interested in the shelf if no one else. I have a compact car but can bring a friend and a hand truck.

jules: tagging @morgan since they asked earlier — also FYI I live nearby and can help with stairs if needed.

morgan: thanks! I actually just got a new shelf last month so passing on the bookcase. alex, you good to coordinate pick up time with sienna?

alex: yep — sienna what time on Friday works? I can do 10am-12pm or after 5pm.

sienna: 10:30am Friday works. address is 456 3rd St (SOMA). curbside by loading dock C. i'll leave a note on the door.

alex: perfect. i'll bring a dolly and @jules if they're free. leaving a calendar invite now.

office-bot: Calendar invite created: "Pickup - Oak Bookcase" Fri 10:30am — 2 attendees.

ben: i'll grab the tickets! DMing you for seat transfer details. :tada:

sienna: tickets spoken for (ben) and bookcase claimed (alex + jules). thanks y'all. if anything falls through i'll ping this thread.

morgan: awesome, glad they found homes. post a pic after move? :heart:

sienna: will do. :)
